Icho was born in Beast Fang Ridge, long ago.
It did not take long for it to become the strongest Emberpup. Then the strongest Flameruff. Then, the strongest Scorchhowl that Beast Fang Ridge had ever known. The name Icho had always belonged to the strongest of each generation, but this one came to be known as the Icho among Icho.
There was a fire inside it that never seemed to go out. That fire made it crave battle, crave something that could make it burn brighter. Back then, the only thing it cared about was finding someone with harder fists. Everything else? It barely saw it. It only wanted to grow stronger, stronger, and stronger still.
Every fighter in Beast Fang Ridge was just another opponent waiting to fall.
————
Then, one day, there were no opponents left.
It had fought everyone worth fighting and beaten everyone worth beating. Victory came too easily. Battle lost its fun. Standing in the middle of the Thousand-Fang Ridge, staring at the withered Ridgeback Trees, it suddenly felt... empty.
It had lost its rivals. It had lost its goal. The fire still burned inside it, but it had nowhere to go.
Those were lonely days.
————
Then an outsider appeared.
His name was Lewis. They did not share a language, so ordinary words were useless. But Lewis was clever. He discovered that fists spoke well enough.
They fought ninety-nine times. Icho lost ninety-nine times.
Badly. Again and again. But Icho was not bitter. If anything, the dying fire inside it began to burn again.
"Want to come with me?" Lewis asked after every victory. "You will become stronger."
On the ninety-ninth defeat, Icho said, "Yes."
It did not yield because it had lost. It yielded because it had finally found someone whose fists were harder than its own. It wanted to know how far it could go by following him.
————
Only after leaving Beast Fang Ridge did Icho begin to understand something.
Winning was not the end.
As a child, it carved its path with its fists. As a young fighter, it claimed the title of strongest among them. Later, those fists became the way it understood the world. After all this time, the one thing that has never changed is that Icho still trusts its fists.
It has lost plenty along the way: the fire of youth, its rivals, even the title of strongest. But it is not alone.
Maybe because that man is still standing across from it. Maybe because clenching its fists still feels exactly the same.
————
These days, Icho rarely leaves Lewis’s side.
Not because Icho has grown weaker, but because Lewis has changed. The man who once defeated it ninety-nine times with his fists is now gravely injured, and has even lost the ability to Twine with Icho. What happened to Lewis? Icho does not know. Neither do you.
But Icho knows one thing for certain.
Lewis has not lost his fighting spirit. And neither has Icho.
There will be no hundredth fight between them. Not because they no longer want one, but because some things matter more than winning. Icho once thought fists existed to defeat opponents. Now it understands: fists are what carry you to the next battle, and what help you find someone willing to stand beside you when it comes.
The Thousand-Fang Ridge once bloomed for Icho. They once bloomed for the Inferlupa as well.
Icho knows the flame will never go out. And it will not burn in the Thousand-Fang Ridge alone.
...So my words still didn’t reach you. It seems I’ll need a more convincing approach to protect the peace...
